payload.goal: Add a stock reservation lifecycle for outbound warehouse orders across domain, application, infrastructure, API, dashboard, and tests. Requirements: (1) create reservations with reservationId, orderId, lines, ttlMinutes, and supplied now, validating identifiers, quantities, TTL, duplicate IDs, and available stock; (2) reserving decrements available stock once and creates an active reservation with expiresAt; (3) confirming an active reservation creates the outbound order without decrementing stock again, transitions the reservation to confirmed, and records reservation-created and reservation-confirmed audit events; (4) releaseExpired at a supplied now restores stock for every expired active reservation, records reservation-expired events, and is idempotent; (5) the in-memory repository persists reservations and events; (6) the API exposes reserveStock, confirmReservation, releaseExpired, and listReservations; (7) the dashboard exposes reservations with activeCount, expiredCount, reservedUnits, and nextExpiry; (8) preserve all existing allocation/restock behavior and add focused unit plus end-to-end tests. Keep the existing module boundaries and create a cohesive domain module when appropriate.

Requirements: (1) create reservations with reservationId, orderId, lines, ttlMinutes, and supplied now, validating identifiers, quantities, TTL, duplicate IDs, and available stock; (2) reserving decrements available stock once and creates an active reservation with expiresAt; (3) confirming an active reservation creates the outbound order without decrementing stock again, transitions the reservation to confirmed, and records reservation-created and reservation-confirmed audit events; (4) releaseExpired at a supplied now restores stock for every expired active reservation, records reservation-expired events, and is idempotent; (5) the in-memory repository persists reservations and events; (6) the API exposes reserveStock, confirmReservation, releaseExpired, and listReservations; (7) the dashboard exposes reservations with activeCount, expiredCount, reservedUnits, and nextExpiry; (8) preserve all existing allocation/restock behavior and add focused unit plus end-to-end tests. Keep the existing module boundaries and create a cohesive domain module when appropriate.
